summary: Lincoln FPA wooden L-4 tower on Stodt (Stott) Mountain, built 1954, manned into 1970 and abandoned in 1972; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: wooden L-4 tower with a 14x14 cab and split-cedar legs
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1972; the register lists it among former lookout sites, and no removal date is given

staffing.status: manned into 1970: Marcella Coy in 1967, the only regularly manned lookout on the district from 1969, the only one kept manned through the 1970 season; abandoned in 1972

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 32 feet; the Lincoln FPA annual reports, as quoted by Oregon Lookouts, give 30 feet. The record keeps 9.1 m, which matches the 30-foot figure from the 1953 and 1954 reports.
All three sources give 1972 as the abandonment year. None gives a removal date, so the story does not say the tower was taken down.

sources.title: Stodt (Stott) Mountain Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites register

notes_for_editor: The 1953 and 1954 Lincoln FPA report lines and the 1967 to 1972 staffing items come through Oregon Lookouts; the originals were not read. The 1967 Forest Log item is quoted there, not checked at the source. The page header gives township 27S-9W-35 while the 1954 report gives 7S 9W 35; the story does not use either. An Oregon Osborne index entry (orww.org) shows Stodt Mountain with a 1953 start, but its stop-year column did not come through in the cached text, so it is not cited. Two searches found no source on what remains at the summit or on access, so the story says so. The register's height (32 ft) conflicts with the annual-report height (30 ft).
